mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE boardDate < #{value} + 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS WHERE commentsDate < #{value} + 1

WITH date_range AS ( SELECT TRUNC(#{startDate}) + LEVEL - 1 AS dt FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= TRUNC(#{endDate}) - TRUNC(#{startDate}) + 1 ) SELECT TO_CHAR(d.dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regDate, NVL(COUNT(b.boardDate), 0) AS cnt FROM date_range d LEFT JOIN BOARD b ON TRUNC(b.boardDate) = d.dt GROUP BY d.dt ORDER BY d.dt

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT b.boardId, b.boardTitle, b.boardName, b.boardViewCount, b.boardDate,
NVL(l.likeCount, 0) AS boardLikeCount, NVL(c.commentCount, 0) AS commentCount,
b.movieTitle
FROM BOARD b
-- 좋아요 수 집계 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT boardId, COUNT(*) AS likeCount FROM BOARD_LIKE GROUP BY boardId ) l ON b.boardId = l.boardId
-- 댓글 수 집계 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT boardId, COUNT(*) AS commentCount FROM COMMENTS GROUP BY boardId ) c ON b.boardId = c.boardId
ORDER BY (NVL(b.boardViewCount, 0) * 1) + (NVL(l.likeCount, 0) * 2) + (NVL(c.commentCount, 0) * 2) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10
